title: Zesty Grilled Tunisian Shrimp Skewers
description: A refreshing and flavorful Tunisian dish featuring grilled shrimp skewers, perfect for a light brunch, with a zesty cider sauce and a side of mixed greens. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is sure to delight your taste buds.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together apple cider, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the shrimp to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Grill the shrimp skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are pink and cooked through.
While the shrimp are cooking, prepare the mixed greens by rinsing them with cold water and draining well.
To serve, place a grilled shrimp skewer on top of a bed of mixed greens and drizzle with any remaining marinade.
Garnish with lemon wedges and serve immediately.
